items.text: Public health and epidemiology careers focus on protecting groups of people through surveillance, programme design, data analysis and communication, and they suit graduates from health, science and social backgrounds who can combine field work with statistics and clear writing.
Learn data handling and programme basics, get field exposure through a project or internship, and choose between government, NGO, research and industry paths.
Read official notices and the course regulator's guidance.
